counts_as_exam_score.description: True only for a timed attempt. A practice attempt is never an exam score.
counts_as_exam_score.title: Counts As Exam Score

expires_at.description: Timed attempts only. Server time after which answers are refused.
expires_at.title: Expires At

score_points.description: Null until the attempt is closed.
score_points.title: Score Points

is_tombstone.description: True means the entity was removed on the server: delete the local copy.
is_tombstone.title: Is Tombstone

ExamQuestion.description: A question as delivered during an attempt: never with its key or explanation.
ExamQuestion.title: ExamQuestion

max_points.description: Points that can be scored automatically (multiple choice).
max_points.title: Max Points

question_count.description: Questions available in the requested language.
question_count.title: Question Count

assessment_mode.description: These questions include their answer keys and must never be used for graded or high-stakes assessment.
assessment_mode.title: Assessment Mode

replayed.description: True when this op_id had already been processed and the stored result is being returned again. No new attempt, score or change was created.
replayed.title: Replayed

result.description: Canonical server result for accepted operations.
result.title: Result

status.description: `accepted`: applied (now or on an earlier attempt). `rejected`: permanently refused; do not retry this op_id. `conflict`: this op_id was already used with different content; nothing changed.
status.title: Status

answer_key.description: Shipped so the phone can give feedback OFFLINE. Practice only: the server still re-scores every synced answer itself.
answer_key.title: Answer Key

id.description: question_revision_id to send back in practice_answer.
id.title: Id

next_cursor.description: Opaque. Store it only after applying `changes`.
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

results.description: One result per op, in request order.
results.title: Results

server_version.description: This account's latest change version after the push.
server_version.title: Server Version

revealed.description: False while the key of this question is still withheld.
revealed.title: Revealed

resumed.description: True when an open timed attempt was returned instead of a new one.
resumed.title: Resumed

feedback_available.description: True in practice mode. In timed mode nothing is revealed before finishing.
feedback_available.title: Feedback Available

is_correct.description: Null in timed mode and for open answers (not scored automatically).
is_correct.title: Is Correct

client_recorded_at.description: When the phone recorded the action. Untrusted display metadata: never used for ordering or scoring, and not part of the payload digest.
client_recorded_at.title: Client Recorded At

op_id.description: Client-generated UUID, created ONCE when the action happens offline and reused unchanged on every retry.
op_id.title: Op Id

payload.description: Shape depends on `kind`: see PracticeAnswerPayload / LessonCompletedPayload.
payload.title: Payload

post.description:
Apply a small batch of offline operations for the signed-in learner.

* Safe to retry: resend the SAME batch (same `op_id`s) until you receive a
  response. Already-applied operations come back with `replayed: true`.
* HTTP 200 does not mean every operation was accepted — read each result.
* The whole batch is one database transaction. On a 5xx nothing was applied.

413.description: Request body or batch too large.
